title: Machine Learning-Based Modeling of Spatio-Temporally Varying Responses of Rainfed Corn Yield to Climate, Soil, and Management in the U.S. Corn Belt
summary: Analysis reports nonlinear temperature effects and county yield prediction R² up to .781. County data across nine states and years; repeated train/test splits; observational associations are not causal.
ai_technology: Random forest and related models estimate county-level rainfed corn yield and predictor associations.
